endpoint.text: Spleen response rate, defined as the proportion of subjects with >=35% spleen volume reduction (SVR) at the end of Cycle 6 (EOC6) by MRI/CT, confirmed 4 weeks later.

citations.quote: The primary endpoint in the JAKARTA and JAKARTA-2 trials was the spleen response rate (RR) defined as the proportion of subjects with \ge 35\% of spleen volume reduction (SVR) at the end of Cycle 6 (EOC6) assessed by MRI/CT scan and confirmed 4 weeks later.
In the JAKARTA study a total of 289 patients were randomized (ITT population).

result.text: Spleen response rate 36.5% with fedratinib 400 mg (N=96) vs 1% placebo (N=96) at EOC6 (p<0.0001); median duration of spleen response 18.2 months. Key secondary symptom response rate 40.4% vs 8.6% placebo (p<0.0001).

citations.quote: The analysis of the primary efficacy endpoint in the JAKARTA trial showed that 36.5% of patients in the 400 mg fedratinib arm compared to 1% of patients in the placebo arm achieved \ge 35\% of spleen volume reduction (SVR) at the EOC6 confirmed 4 weeks later (p < 0.0001). The median duration of spleen response in the fedratinib 400 mg arm was 18.2 months.

indication.text: INREBIC is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of adult patients with intermediate-2 or high-risk primary or secondary (post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocytopenia) myelofibrosis (MF).

citations.quote: INREBIC® is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with intermediate-2 or high-risk primary or secondary (post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocytopenia) myelofibrosis (MF).

target_moa.text: Fedratinib is an oral kinase inhibitor with activity against wild type and mutationally activated Janus Associated Kinase 2 (JAK2) and FLT3; it reduces STAT3/5 phosphorylation, inhibits cell proliferation, and induces apoptosis, with IC50 of ~3 nM for JAK2 and greater potency for JAK2 over other JAK family members.

citations.quote: Fedratinib (INREBIC®) is an oral kinase inhibitor with activity against wild type and mutationally activated Janus Associated Kinase 2 (JAK2) and FMS-like tyrosine kinase 3 (FLT3).
- Mechanism: Fedratinib inhibits (IC_{50}) Janus Kinase 2 (JAK2) (3 nM for WT & mutant), inhibits (IC_{50}) JAK1 (46 nM), JAK3 (96 nM), and TYK2 (171 nM), and inhibits FLT3 (15 nM).
*Fedratinib is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of primary or secondary myelofibrosis.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=20%) were diarrhea (66%), nausea (62%), anemia, and vomiting (39%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 21% of patients, including cardiac failure (5%) and anemia (2%); fatal cardiogenic shock occurred in 1%. Serious/fatal encephalopathy including Wernicke's occurred in 1.3% (8/608), fatal in 0.16% (1/608).

citations.quote: Gastrointestinal toxicities are the most frequent adverse reactions in INREBIC-treated patients. During the randomized treatment period, diarrhea occurred in 66% of patients, nausea in 62% of patients, and vomiting in 39% of patients.

Serious adverse reactions occurred in 21% of INREBIC-treated patients. Serious adverse reactions in \ge 2\% of patients receiving INREBIC 400 mg daily included cardiac failure (5%) and anemia (2%). Fatal adverse reactions of cardiogenic shock occurred in 1% of patients receiving INREBIC 400 mg daily.
Serious cases were reported in 1.3% (8/608) of patients treated with INREBIC in clinical trials and 0.16% (1/608) of cases were fatal.

detail.text: WARNING: ENCEPHALOPATHY INCLUDING WERNICKE'S — Serious and fatal encephalopathy, including Wernicke's, has occurred in patients treated with INREBIC. Assess thiamine levels prior to and during treatment; do not start INREBIC in patients with thiamine deficiency; if encephalopathy is suspected, immediately discontinue.

requirement.text: 3664-1: Conduct a randomized, concurrently controlled clinical trial comparing fedratinib 400 mg once daily to best available therapy in patients with DIPSS-intermediate-2 or high-risk MF previously treated with ruxolitinib, ensuring at least 150 subjects treated with at least 6 cycles and followed at least 3 years.

citations.quote: 3664-1 Conduct a randomized, concurrently controlled clinical trial comparing fedratinib 400 mg once daily to best available therapy in patients with DIPSS-intermediate-2 or high-risk primary myelofibrosis, post-polycythemia vera myelofibrosis, or post-essential thrombocytopenia myelofibrosis and previously treated with ruxolitinib. The trial will enroll a sufficient number of patients to ensure that at least 150 subjects are treated with at least 6 cycles of fedratinib and are followed for at least 3 years from first dose, or until death.

summary.text: INREBIC (fedratinib) received regular (not accelerated) approval under a Priority Review NDA based on demonstration of meaningful clinical benefit and statistically significant reduction in spleen volume and myelofibrosis-related symptoms in the Phase 3 JAKARTA trial. It had Orphan Drug Designation for the treatment of secondary and primary myelofibrosis. No advisory committee meeting was held.
